facts.fact: OGE 2026 sets Kz 159.2bn (about USD 172.6m) for the Programa de Expansão e Modernização das Comunicações, of which Kz 62.7bn (about USD 68m) is the 4G network expansion, as reported by pti.ao from the MINFIN programme table.
facts.system: Programa Expansão e Modernização das Comunicações (OGE 2026)

facts.fact: The programme falls 30.5% from Kz 229.3bn in the 2025 budget to Kz 159.2bn in the 2026 budget; the 4G expansion line falls from Kz 107.8bn to Kz 62.7bn (about 42%).
